description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableDefinitionIdentifier class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. It verifies immutability, equals and hashCode correctness, parsing validity, and getter methods.

classes.name: ImmutableDefinitionIdentifierTest
